method.algorithm: Independent glTF parent-local TRS lerp / shortest quaternion slerp; hierarchy composition; exact source vertex linear blend skinning. No build or runtime code imported.
method.grounding: For 0<run_weight<1, evaluate source sole probes in posed foot coordinates, then root local Y += max(0, .002-probe_minY). Check actual full mesh after correction.
method.weight_definition: Post-smoothstep pose weights, not raw speed fractions; runtime weight=smoothstep(0,.5,actual_speed/2.35).
method.board_surface_basis: world_builder.gd tile center Y=-.062 plus half height .12/2
method.threshold_policy: Pass requires every actual skinned mesh vertex above the real board plane within fixed numerical tolerance and closed loop position; no probe-only acceptance or compensation-size quality threshold.
method.fullfoot_selection: Foot-bone weight >= .5 on the entire foot, with no rest-height or fore-aft exclusion.
method.limits: Discrete fixed-weight straight-cycle poses. Does not certify arbitrary in-between weights/times, dynamic Godot transitions, foot sliding during acceleration/turns, full-body self-collision, GPU output, or human naturalness.
